# DisneyPixar.fr

> A comprehensive French fan database dedicated to Disney and Pixar films, featuring detailed information on upcoming releases, cast and crew, and localization insights.

DisneyPixar.fr is an independent fan site providing curated information about Disney and Pixar productions, including upcoming theatrical releases through 2027 and specialized guides on film dubbing and localization for French audiences.

## Key Topics

- Disney Animation
- Pixar Animation Studios
- Upcoming Films 2026-2027
- Film Cast & Crew
- French Dubbing & Localization
- Walt Disney Pictures
- Walt Disney Animation Studios
- Star Wars Spinoffs
- Live-Action Adaptations
- Animated Features
- Pete Docter
- Jared Bush
- Disney-Pixar Database
- Fan Resources

## Upcoming Films 2026-2027

- [The Mandalorian and Grogu (2026)](https://www.disneypixar.fr/films/517-the-mandalorian-and-grogu): The Mandalorian and Grogu 2026 film by Jon Favreau, Star Wars spinoff
- [Vaiana (2026)](https://www.disneypixar.fr/films/521-vaiana): Vaiana 2026 live-action adaptation directed by Thomas Kail
- [Hexed (2026)](https://www.disneypixar.fr/films/527-hexed): Hexed 2026 Disney animated film by Josie Trinidad and Jason Hand
- [La Reine des neiges 3 (2027)](https://www.disneypixar.fr/films/519-la-reine-des-neiges-3): Frozen III 2027 Disney animation directed by Jennifer Lee
- [Gatto (2027)](https://www.disneypixar.fr/films/526-gatto): Gatto 2027 Pixar animated film directed by Enrico Casarosa

## Resources & Guides

- [Le doublage Disney](https://www.disneypixar.fr/explorer/dossiers/1-le-doublage-disney): Guide to Disney dubbing process, French voice acting, and film localization
